HYBRID WORK MODEL: 3 DAYS PER WEEK (60%) IN OUR WROCLAW OFFICE AND 2 DAYS REMOTE

About us
Hi, we are Ten Square Games, and we live games! No, not a typo - but a level up from loving! We are on a mission of giving players excellent outdoor experiences on their mobiles. With global hits, such as Fishing Clash, we know how to make the best of technology, fun, and fair play. With 77 million registered players in 2025 and 300+ people on board, we keep growing and learning, having the insatiable hunger for the next success. If you also like to explore the unknown and know how to own it, we want to work with you!

What is this job all about?
We are on the lookout for an Art Lead - someone who won’t just create visuals but will shape the entire artistic vision of the product.
If you’re someone who can imagine the look & feel of a game from A to Z, develop visual strategies, create compelling concepts, ensure quality, give constructive feedback, and effectively support and collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams, then this role is for you!
You’ll work closely with 2D Artists, 3D Artists, Concept Artists, and Technical Artists - and you’ll be the driving force behind their creative alignment and output.
